doc.title: Chick Corea — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Interaction with musicians feeds composition
summary: Corea says working with others sparks compositions, using Avishai's contributions to Origin as an example.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Does immersing yourself in his tonal personality, or other musicians, spark musical ideas which thereby generate compositions and a flow of music?
There’s that feedback process that happens for you.

Absolutely. Like I said, it’s a social tendency to want to interact with other musicians and set a game plan to play, and then learn from them, see what they bring to the table. Because like I say, it’s not like Mozart Piano Concerto where all the notes are written. It’s this song form, and a form that everyone improvises off of, which means that the musicians now bring a lot to it, and Avishai certainly brought a lot to it. Origin had a couple of his nice compositions in it, too.
